title: AssetBatchImport
description: Batch wrapper for multiple asset records exchanged together. Each record is a complete asset record and is validated independently against the asset schema. Asset records refer to collections through their embedded collections objects, which can name a parent collection or member assets by identifier. The array length does not establish that the batch is complete. How records are stored or tracked after exchange is outside this schema.

schema_version.description: Version of the batch schema (semantic versioning, e.g., '1.0.0').

extensions.description: Extension point for batch-level custom fields or plugin data. Keys SHOULD be prefixed with 'x_' or 'custom_' to avoid collision with future standard fields.

assets.description: Array of fully embedded asset records. Each must conform to the Asset schema.
